amendments.was: The mu=50 card is byte-identical to the release production card (hash-compared).
amendments.becomes: The mu=50 card is PHYSICS-IDENTICAL to the release card: the identity hash is computed over the card with the TreeWriter output block excluded. Output-only TreeWriter additions (the two branches in configs/g/branch_schema.yaml card_requirements) are permitted and their diff is stored in the card manifest.
amendments.reason: The ntuple extension requires persisting EFlowMerger/eflow (pre-PUPPI candidates) and PileUpMerger/stableParticles (pileup gen record). Without the latter, reconstructed candidates' truth references into pileup GenParticles DANGLE on serialization — pu_fraction is uncomputable and §7.7(c) truth-survival fails by construction. TreeWriter branches change which collections are WRITTEN, not any physics module, seed, or algorithm: the simulated event content is bit-identical.
amendments.verification: make_mu_cards.py asserts physics-section hash equality between the mu50 variant and the release card, and stores the full TreeWriter diff; the G2 closure test (schema + distributions + frozen-checkpoint scoring vs the public release) remains the end-to-end guarantee.

amendments.was: seed_weaver.py sets one global RNG seed and hands off; §9.3 head-seed = sha256(K:seed); §9.2 selects on final-checkpoint validation loss; seed_weaver.py not in the frozen set; job memory 64Gi.
amendments.becomes: seed_weaver.py (a) injects a run-seed torch.Generator into every DataLoader so base_seed — hence the per-worker numpy seeds driving shuffle AND reweight sampling — is a function of the run seed ONLY, making the batch stream identical across arms (the §9.3 twin invariant); (b) sets the §3 cuDNN determinism policy; (c) writes batch_stream_sha (per-worker seeds) for the pairing/§9.7 checks. seed_weaver.py is ADDED to the frozen-file set (config_hash re-hashed 349b3eb5->11931c79). The literal §9.3 head-seed sha256(K:seed) is SUPERSEDED: the head derives deterministically from the shared run seed after the identical backbone (reproducible per (K,seed), arm-specific by shape) — no pairing property changes, and a post-hoc re-init would risk an init-distribution mismatch. §9.2: the network eval fn now logs 'Eval AvgLoss', so the final-checkpoint validation-loss selection is computable from train.log. Job memory 64Gi->80Gi (recipe-neutral; NOT in config_hash) after Stage-0 OOMed at the epoch-0 validation accumulation.
amendments.reason: Adversarial audit 2026-07-19 traced (weaver train.py + torch dataloader) that weaver builds DataLoaders with generator=None, so base_seed is drawn from the live global RNG AFTER the per-K head consumes num_classes-dependent draws -> arms silently saw a different jet order and multiset, violating the 'same sampled jet stream' invariant the paired comparison rests on (inflates the paired-difference variance; would make a false identical-stream claim). The recipe also never set the §3 cuDNN flags, emitted no batch_stream_sha, and logged only val accuracy though §9.2 selects on val loss.
amendments.verification: Free cross-arm smoke test: two arms at the same seed must now print identical weaver worker seeds (dataset.py) and identical batch_stream_sha (they differed before the fix). py_compile of all changed files; reviewer re-check of the diff before any confirmatory launch. No make_weight re-run: the reweight auto-configs key on the data-config md5 (unchanged), independent of the network/seed files.

amendments.becomes: train_e2.sh dataopts --num-workers 2 (config_hash re-hashed 11931c79->9106183d). num_workers is a loading-parallelism knob only (no optimizer / data-order / label effect), applied identically to all five arms, so the E2 same-sampled-jet-stream invariant is preserved. Also resolves the 5-workers-on-4-CPU oversubscription weaver warned about.
amendments.reason: Stage-0 could not complete an epoch at 64Gi OR 80Gi: the buffered-read + worker-buffer footprint expands to fill available RAM and the anonymous worker buffers still spike past the cgroup limit (empirically pinned at the 80Gi ceiling during epoch-0 training; one arm OOM-killed at 30 min, before validation). Raising memory does not help; reducing concurrent whole-file worker buffers is the root-cause fix. Seeding/determinism untouched (seed_weaver unchanged) so the A2 pairing proof still holds.
amendments.verification: freeze_steps.py recomputes config_hash=9106183d over the 4 frozen files; py_compile clean; relaunched Stage-0 is monitored through epoch-0 validation to confirm it completes without OOM before the remaining arms launch.
